_note: The water currency glyph, redrawn. The shipped ui/shared/icon_water.png was not blank art — at
256 it carries real paper fibre and a hairline rim — but every mark on it is HIGH-FREQUENCY, and
the wallet pill draws it about 45px tall. At that size the fibre and the rim average away and the
droplet renders as a flat solid blue slab, which is what the owner saw. Nothing in the runtime
path could fix that: the art carried no FORM, only texture.
Regenerated at 512 with the low-frequency modelling that survives phone size (art-style-guide.md
4: one flat base colour plus at most one same-hue shadow plane) — a broad matte lit plane on the
upper left, the sky-blue base, ONE same-hue darker plane hugging the lower right, a fine warm cut
edge, 2-4% paper fibre, no baked shadow. Silhouette and proportion are the shipped droplet's
(0.700 wide-to-tall against its 0.707), so nothing in the pill's layout moves.
